newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot propane up on demand.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot propane up on demand.

text.p: Cold weather that brought snow to western Canada and demand for automotive fuel pressured prices of spot Canada propane higher this week, players said on Thursday.
In the snow-covered hub of Edmonton, spot propane traded this week between 30.50 cents and 31.00 cents a gallon, about a penny higher from last Thursday.
"We've got cool weather here and there has been some late season heating demand," said a western trader, who added there was also steady demand for propane as an automative fuel.
The eastern hub of Sarnia was steady from last Thursday at 37.50/38.50 cents, finding support from relatively strong values in U.S. markets.
Sarnia isobutane firmed about two cents to 46.00 cents due largely to tight supply. The butane markets, however, were seasonally quiet as players build up inventory.
